images.title: The Tunbridge Wells Circular Path on Groombridge Hill - geograph.org.uk - 1735722.jpg
images.author: David Anstiss
images.caption:
The Tunbridge Wells Circular Path on Groombridge Hill The long distance path heads left through Beech Wood towards Top Hill Farm. The B2110 Groombridge Hill heads towards Langton Green from Groombridge.
In the background is a cottage called 'The Cottage' !!
